planned_assets.command: mmx image generate --prompt Square top-down game UI feedback icon for a cute candy roguelite, level-up burst made of golden star sugar, pink candy sparkles, tiny blue sugar crystals, centered object, thick high contrast outline, simple readable silhouette at 32px, flat #00ff00 chroma-key background, no text, no watermark. --aspect-ratio 1:1 --n 1 --out-dir asset/generated_candidates/2026-05-26_mmx_level_up_feedback_pack/images --out-prefix ui_level_up_spark_icon_v001 --output json --non-interactive --quiet

mmx speech synthesize --text 糖晶能量升级完成！选择新的糖果魔法吧！ --voice Chinese (Mandarin)_Warm_Girl --language zh --format mp3 --out asset/generated_candidates/2026-05-26_mmx_level_up_feedback_pack/audio/voice_level_up_cn_v001.mp3 --output json --non-interactive --quiet

mmx music generate --prompt Three second instrumental level-up jingle for a cute candy roguelite, bright candy bells, tiny sugar crystal arpeggio, fizzy sparkle tail, cheerful success feeling, no vocals, no lyrics, clean ending, suitable for repeated game UI feedback. --instrumental --format mp3 --out asset/generated_candidates/2026-05-26_mmx_level_up_feedback_pack/music/jingle_level_up_v001_source.mp3 --output json --non-interactive --quiet

limitations: This validator checks an mmx generation plan only; it does not call mmx or create media files.
A valid plan must still produce metadata manifests, candidate validation reports, postprocess outputs, and human review records before any Runtime candidate promotion.
A valid plan does not mark assets as accepted_content, runtime_integrated, release_ready, or visually/audio approved.
